quick.summary: Why reports keep breaking, and how to stop bad data at the source.
quick.takeaway: Do not just patch the data. Fix the system that makes it.

beats.line: The cost report failed again. I patch it every week. Why so often?
Imagine a doctor. If your knee hurts every week, a bandage is bad.
Right. They need to find out why I keep hurting my knee.
Exactly. Do not just fix the missing data. Fix what creates it.
We need to execute a root cause analysis.
Can I just say hunting the real bug?
Perfect. Hunt the real bug down.
So I ask the team making the source file to fix their export.
Yes. Stop the bad data before it ever reaches your desk.

quiz.question: A report fails every week for the exact same reason. What should you do?
options: Find and fix the source of the bad data.
Write a script to silently ignore the error.
Set aside time every week to run the patch.
quiz.explanation: Finding the real bug means fixing the system that creates the bad data, not just patching it.

quiz.question: Fixing the final table is the best way to handle recurring errors.
quiz.explanation: Fixing the final table is just a bandage. You must solve the root cause to stop the cycle.
